Complete Operational Flow

1. What is this App? (App Kya Hai Aur Kya Kam Karega?)
Overview: Yeh app ek Real-time AI Executive Interview Simulator hai. User mobile ka front camera open karke ek
realistic 3D AI HR Avatar ke samne baithkar 15-30 min ka live interview de sakta hai. AI Candidate ki voice aur front
camera ke zariye unke Confidence, Eye-Contact, aur Smile Score ko real-time tracking karega.

1. What is this App? (App Kya Hai Aur Kya Kam Karega?)
Overview: Yeh app ek Real-time AI Executive Interview Simulator hai. User mobile ka front camera open karke ek
realistic 3D AI HR Avatar ke samne baithkar 15-30 min ka live interview de sakta hai. AI Candidate ki voice aur front
camera ke zariye unke Confidence, Eye-Contact, aur Smile Score ko real-time tracking karega.
2. Complete App Working Flow (App Kaise Kaam Karega?)
1.
Step 1: Onboarding & Profile Setup: User app mein apna Name, Target Job Role (Software, Banking, Corporate),
Experience level, aur Resume Text / Certificates upload karega (Real ya Fake records support honge).
2.

Step 1: Onboarding & Profile Setup: User app mein apna Name, Target Job Role (Software, Banking, Corporate),
Experience level, aur Resume Text / Certificates upload karega (Real ya Fake records support honge).
2.
Step 2: HR Character & Company Selection: User 4-5 Avatar Characters mein se apna interviewer select karega (e.g.,
Rohan - Friendly Tech HR, Ananya - Corporate HR, Vikram - Strict FAANG Lead). Company select karega (Google,
Microsoft, JP Morgan, ya Normal Practice).
3.
Step 3: The Virtual Desk Room: User ka camera open hoga. Screen par Avatar office desk aur chair par baitha dikhega. AI
HR table par rakhe User Profile/Certificates read karne ka gesture karega.
4.

Step 3: The Virtual Desk Room: User ka camera open hoga. Screen par Avatar office desk aur chair par baitha dikhega. AI
HR table par rakhe User Profile/Certificates read karne ka gesture karega.
4.
Step 4: Real-time Live Interview & Vision Sensing: AI HR naturally bolna start karega. Jab user jawab dega, phone ka
Front Camera MediaPipe AI se candidate ka Eye Contact, Head Balance, aur Smile Score tracking karega.
5.
Step 5: Result, Certificate & Social Virality: Interview pass hone par AI user ko overall score ke sath downloadable Verified
Selection Certificate dega (jo LinkedIn/WhatsApp status par flex hoga). Reject hone par dynamic HR rejection feedback
recording milegi.
